page.overview:
Who is Brun?

Brun was a male Mandalorian scout of Clan Vizla who lived during the Third Galactic War.

He was sent by Lane Vizla to investigate rumours of a basilisk war droid laboratory on Ruhnuk along with Dekk and Vath, however the three of them ended up captured by Kur Ha'rangir. Thought to be dead, Lane sent the Alliance Commander to follow their tracks, however the commander eventually ended up rescuing the three of them and they made their way back to Lane.
